name: When I Was Born for the Seventh Time

podcast.body: This was Cornershop's third album, released in 1997, and it featured their major alt-rock radio hit "Brimful of Asha." The album's success was largely propelled by this single. "The track was included on the group's third album when I was born for the seventh time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2
